command:
sudo -n -H bash -c '
printf "%s\n" "NODE=$(hostname)"
printf "%s\n" "---FAILED_UNITS---"
systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain 2>&1 || true
printf "%s\n" "---UNSAVED_CONFIG_REDACTED---"
COMPARE=$( ( . /opt/vyatta/etc/functions/script-template; configure; compare; exit ) 2>&1 )
if [ -z "$COMPARE" ]; then
  printf "%s\n" "unsaved=none"
else
  printf "%s\n" "unsaved=present"
  printf "%s\n" "$COMPARE" | grep -viE "private-key|pre-shared-secret|password|secret|credential" || true
  if printf "%s\n" "$COMPARE" | grep -qiE "private-key|pre-shared-secret|password|secret|credential"; then printf "%s\n" "unsaved_sensitive=present_redacted"; fi
fi
printf "%s\n" "---SAVED_TUNNEL_ROUTE_FIREWALL_NAT_LINES---"
grep -E "wg01|10\\.10\\.1|10\\.10\\.2|10\\.255\\.255|firewall|nat" /config/config.boot 2>/dev/null | grep -viE "private-key|pre-shared-secret|password|secret|credential" | head -100 || true
printf "%s\n" "---WG_LINKS_ROUTES---"
ip -br link
wg show all 2>&1
ip route show
printf "%s\n" "---NAT_FIREWALL_KERNEL_LINES---"
nft list ruleset 2>&1 | grep -E "table |chain |masquerade|snat|dnat|hook |policy |dport (22|51820|8080)" || true
printf "%s\n" "---LISTENERS_AND_UNIT_FLAGS---"
ss -lntup 2>&1 || true
for u in ssh sshd wg-quick@wg01; do systemctl is-enabled "$u" 2>&1 || true; done
printf "%s\n" "---ARTIFACT_NAME_SCAN---"
find /tmp /var/tmp /root /home -xdev -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname "*wireguard*" -o -iname "*wg*" -o -iname "*.sh" -o -iname "*.tar*" -o -iname "*.zip" -o -iname "*key*" -o -iname "*secret*" -o -iname "*credential*" \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -100
